newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity says restructure news on track.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity says restructure news on track.

text.p: LucasVarity Plc, the automotive and aerospace components group, said on Friday its plan remained to give details of the next layer of its ongoing resturcturing before the end of this year.
Earlier, London share market sources said that an uptick in the company's share price on Friday was prompted by talk that the announcement on restructuring would be made next week.
"We are expecting to make a statement concerning a further level of restructuring before the end of the year," a company spokeswoman told Reuters, but added it had not announced a date.
Asked if it could come at any time, she said, "Yes".

LucasVarity, formed earlier this year after merger of Varity Corp of the U.S. and Lucas Industries Plc, has already announced its plans to reshape its senior management level, but the company has also said that there would be another level of reorganisation to be addressed in due course.

According to media reports not confirmed by the company, chief executive Victor Rice has considered reorganising the various pre-merger business structures, mainly working with braking technology and diesel engines and systems, to better reflect market needs.
He is also reported to have considered a new name and corporate image to improve its profile.
During the morning, LucasVarity's share price rose to 255 pence before stabilising up 7.0 pence on the day at 253-1/2p.
